DitherScrollReveal.end: photo ends on the picture itself, dither on the finest dither.
DitherScrollReveal.coarsest: How many cells wide the first, coarsest blocks are.
DitherScrollReveal.start: Where the top edge is when the reveal starts, as a share of the scroll area from the top. 1 is the bottom edge.
DitherScrollReveal.finish: Where the top edge is when the reveal is done.
DitherScrollReveal.viewport-height: Height of the scroll area. Set it and the reveal follows the scroll.
DitherScrollReveal.viewport-top: Where the scroll area starts in the window.
DitherScrollReveal.progress: The reveal by hand, 0 to 1. Used when viewport-height is 0.
DitherScrollReveal.shown: The progress being drawn, read only.
